en.html:
Your purpose is fully clear now. Only doing it remains. Kill her. You could strangle her. Smash her chest, crush her belly, drown her, make her breathe gas, or set her on fire. She is a helpless sick person. Whichever way you choose, killing her would be easy. Go on, then.
Choices
  • Stab her to death.
  • Strangle her.
  • Beat her to death.
  • Cut her down.
  • Poison her.
  • Run her over.
